---
title: "Beyond the Mean Field"
description: "When one averaged unit per region is not enough: spiking cells, ion channels, and multi-scale models."
---

Most TVBO models put a single averaged unit — a neural mass — at each region. This
topic covers what to do when that is not enough: modelling individual spiking cells
and their channels, and coupling a detailed patch to a whole-brain model.

## Do

- Single neurons, ion channels and synapses are available by reference: set
  `iri: neuroml:<TypeName>` on a dynamics and TVBO pulls the equations from the
  NeuroML2 library. See [IRI vs. inline YAML](../Interoperability/NeuroML/IRI_vs_YAML.qmd)
  and the [example gallery](../Interoperability/NeuroML/examples/index.qmd).

## Understand

- [Multi-scale modelling](MultiScaleModelling.qmd) — what it means to run two scales
  together, which pairings TVBO supports today, and an honest status for each.
